import { Flex, Text, Image, Icon } from '@aws-amplify/ui-react';

export default function FigmaHomeLayout() {
  return (
    <Flex
      width="1440px"
      height="2713px"
      position="relative"
      border="0px SOLID rgba(229,231,235,1)"
      backgroundColor="rgba(249,250,251,1)"
    >
      <Flex
        gap="0"
        direction="column"
        width="100%"
        height="100%"
        justifyContent="center"
        alignItems="center"
        position="absolute"
        top="0"
        left="0"
      >
        <Image
          src="https://via.placeholder.com/1440x2713"
          alt="Figma design"
          width="100%"
          height="100%"
          objectFit="cover"
        />
        <Flex
          gap="0"
          direction="column"
          width="100%"
          height="100%"
          justifyContent="center"
          alignItems="center"
          position="absolute"
          top="0"
          left="0"
          backgroundColor="rgba(249,250,251,0.8)"
        >
          <Text
            fontSize="32px"
            fontWeight="700"
            color="rgba(31,41,55,1)"
            textAlign="center"
            padding="24px"
          >
            Welcome to Our Website
          </Text>
          <Text
            fontSize="18px"
            fontWeight="400"
            color="rgba(75,85,99,1)"
            textAlign="center"
            padding="0 24px 24px 24px"
          >
            We are glad to have you here. Explore our services and offerings.
          </Text>
          <Flex
            gap="16px"
            direction="row"
            width="100%"
            justifyContent="center"
            alignItems="center"
            padding="0 24px"
          >
            <Icon
              name="arrow-right"
              size="24px"
              color="rgba(255,255,255,1)"
              backgroundColor="rgba(0,104,255,1)"
              borderRadius="50%"
              padding="8px"
              cursor="pointer"
            />
            <Text
              fontSize="18px"
              fontWeight="600"
              color="rgba(0,104,255,1)"
              textAlign="center"
              padding="12px 24px"
              borderRadius="4px"
              backgroundColor="rgba(229,231,235,1)"
              cursor="pointer"
            >
              Get Started
            </Text>
          </Flex>
        </Flex>
      </Flex>
    </Flex>
  );
}
